pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft-gradient edges. Dark regions exhibit high spatial area on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries toward the ventral and limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space pathways forming a mesh-like topology. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway width is relatively uniform across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck and shoulder, characterized by dense, short vertical hair tufts creating a jagged silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Rapid transition from large, discrete flank patches to dense, highly fragmented, small-scale spotting on the visible lower foreleg and hindleg.
